title: AN OBSERVATION
author: Sheila Mary Fraser Porter
text:
On our way home from the Cloverdale Recreation Centre we
pass a ditch that`s about a block long.
I quite often see at least five large green plastic garbage bags
lying on the side of the ditch.
Does anyone check to see what`s in them?
Garbage?
Cut up body parts?
Weapons?
Dead animals?
Who throws them there? Do people just get out of their cars,
open up their trunks and toss them out?
I also see lots of plastic bottles, tin drink cans and vegetable cans.
Paper cups and plates, cardboard boxes of all shapes and sizes.

The ditch is covered in green slime
No animal would be caught dead swimming in its water

It`s an eyesore!
